title: IOS XE upgrade procedure
content:
# IOS XE upgrade procedure

All switches run in **install mode**. Upgrade one stack or switch at a time, inside a [[Change windows|change window]].

## Approved releases

| Platform | Approved release | Image file pattern |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Catalyst 9500 | 17.12.x (example) | cat9k_iosxe.<VERSION>.SPA.bin |
| Catalyst 9300 | 17.12.x (example) | cat9k_iosxe.<VERSION>.SPA.bin |
| Catalyst 9200 | 17.12.x (example) | cat9k_lite_iosxe.<VERSION>.SPA.bin |

## Steps

1. Check the current release and that the switch is in install mode:

```
show version
show install summary
```

2. Check free space and remove old packages:

```
dir flash:
install remove inactive
```

3. Copy the image from the file server:

```
copy scp://netadmin@10.10.5.40/images/<IMAGE-FILE> flash:
```

4. Add, activate and commit in one step. The switch (or the whole stack) reloads:

```
install add file flash:<IMAGE-FILE> activate commit
```

5. After the reload, verify:

```
show version
show install summary
show switch
```

## If something goes wrong

- Console in and check `show install summary` for the committed and active packages.
- Roll back with the `install rollback` command to the previous committed state; check the exact options for your release first.
- Record the outcome in the [[Change log]].
